task.title: Discovering device data offline
task.shortdesc: Offline configuration does not require a connection to the network. This procedure uses the utility to discovery device data from the EDE master configuration file and add them to the database.

taskbody.prereq: You have the EDE master configuration file that was exported from the remote station as well as a state text file, which you created manually. The station is connected to the BACnet network and running Workbench.

step.cmd: To discover devices, expand ConfigDrivers and double-click the BacnetNetwork.
step.stepresult: The EDE Bacnet Device Manager opens.
The discovery job opens the EDE File Chooser window.A key serves as an ID associated with the EDE master configuration file and state texts f ile.

step.cmd: To populate the location properties, select the key from the EDE Configuration Selection drop-down list.
step.stepresult: The EDE File Chooser automatically populates the location properties with file paths.

step.cmd: If this set of configuration files does not have a key yet, click Add.
step.stepresult: The EDE Configuration window opens with the key property available for editing.

step.cmd: Enter a key value, use the browser folder icons to the right of the location properties to locate the file paths and click OK.
step.info: The next time you use the EDE configuration utility with this set of EDE configuration files, you will not need to browse to the file locations.

step.cmd: With all properties configured, click OK.
step.stepresult: The discovery job finds all the devices present in the EDE configuration files.

step.cmd: To add these data to the database, select one or more devices in the Discovered pane and click Add.
step.stepresult: The devices move from the Discovered pane to the Database pane.
